newsitem.title: USA: Staff Builders doubles credit line.
newsitem.headline: Staff Builders doubles credit line.

text.p: Staff Builders Inc said Thursday it had secured a new credit facility with its bank, Mellon Bank, doubling a prior credit facility scheduled to expire in July 1997.

The new facility consists of a revolving line of credit, a standby letter of credit facility, and an acquisition line of credit, under which the company can borrow up to an aggregate of $50 million, Staff said.
It said $15 million has been earmarked for acquisitions.
The new credit facility is structured to allow Staff additional flexibility in growing its business, it said.
